name: sas-linter-vscode
description: Lint and format SAS source files via the sas-lint binary.

commands.title: SAS Linter: Lint all SAS files in workspace
SAS Linter: Run all autofixes on current file
SAS Linter: Download / update sas-lint binary

sasLinter.path.description: Absolute path to the sas-lint binary. Leave blank to use the bundled auto-downloaded binary.

sasLinter.version.patternErrorMessage: Expected a release tag like v0.3.2 (or 0.3.2), or blank for the default.
sasLinter.version.description: Release tag of the sas-lint binary to auto-download, e.g. v0.3.2 (see github.com/mes-amis/sas-linter-rs/releases). Leave blank for the version pinned by this extension. Ignored when sasLinter.path is set.

sasLinter.config.description: Path to a sas-linter YAML config (relative to the workspace root, or absolute). Leave blank for sas-lint's default search.

enumDescriptions: Lint every SAS file in the workspace — *.sas plus any files.associations glob mapped to sas — on load, when the associations change, and when files change on disk.
Lint only files open in an editor.
sasLinter.scope.description: Which files the linter reports on. Ignored when sasLinter.run is manual.

sasLinter.format.enabled.description: Register sas-lint --format as the document formatter for SAS files.
